items.text: With a fake agent: a node starts when its needs are met, and 3 nodes or fewer run at the same time
The prompt of a node has only its ID, round and brief path; the same node in a changed graph has the same prompt
A node becomes blocked after 3 rounds, after 2 rounds with the same evidence, and after an out-of-scope report
A fix adds a `passed: false` item and blocks only the nodes that have not started and share files or screens with it
The return of the Workflow fits the schema and is about 300 tokens or fewer; `/run-plan` calls the Workflow
